title: SSH Brute Force Failed Logons
description: Detects many failed SSH logon attempts from a single source in a short window, indicating password guessing / brute force.

title: Successful SSH Logon After Multiple Failures
description: Detects a successful SSH login immediately following a burst of failed attempts from the same source — likely a successful brute force.

title: Suspicious Shell Command Execution
description: Detects shell commands consistent with reconnaissance or tampering, e.g. reading /etc/shadow, editing sudoers, disabling logging.

title: New Local Account Created
description: Detects creation of a new local user account, which can indicate persistence via a backdoor account.

title: Sudoers File Modification
description: Detects modification of /etc/sudoers or sudoers.d, often used to grant unauthorized elevated privileges.

title: System Log Clearing or Truncation
description: Detects deletion or truncation of auth/syslog files, a common indicator-removal technique after a compromise.

title: Suspicious Cron Job Creation
description: Detects new or modified crontab entries that could establish scheduled-task persistence.

title: Access to /etc/shadow
description: Detects attempts to read the shadow password file, associated with credential dumping on Linux hosts.

title: Port Scan Detected
description: Detects a high volume of connection attempts to many distinct ports from a single source in a short window, consistent with nmap-style scanning.

title: Internal Network Sweep
description: Detects sequential connection attempts to many distinct hosts on the same subnet, consistent with host discovery.

title: Remote Tool Download via curl/wget
description: Detects curl or wget being used to fetch an executable or script from an external host, a common ingress-tool-transfer pattern.

title: Reverse Shell Indicators
description: Detects shell command patterns consistent with establishing a reverse shell back to an external IP (e.g. bash -i, nc -e, /dev/tcp).

title: Connection to Known-Bad IP
description: Detects a connection to or from an IP address present in OSINT threat-intel feeds (OTX/abuse.ch/MISP).

title: Mass File Modification / Possible Ransomware
description: Detects a burst of file writes/renames across many files in a short window, consistent with ransomware encryption behavior.

title: Web Application Exploit Attempt
description: Detects request patterns consistent with exploitation attempts against a public-facing web application (SQLi/path traversal/RCE payload strings).
